subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should yielded-parent resumption be one core runtime contract across ACP and native subagents, or should OpenClaw keep landing narrow wake-recovery slices independently?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans ACP relay, native subagent announce delivery, task terminal handoff, and heartbeat ownership, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent wake contract.

options.title: Define One Core Wake Contract
options.body: Treat this issue as the canonical cross-runtime contract and require candidate fixes to compose into heartbeat-independent yielded-parent resumption across ACP and native subagents.

options.title: Land Narrow Slices
options.body: Accept the open PRs as incremental mitigations while keeping broader ACP/native edge cases in separate follow-up issues.

options.title: Document Current Limits
options.body: Defer dedicated yield-wait semantics and document heartbeat or polling limitations as current behavior.

recommendation.title: Define One Core Wake Contract
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the canonical cross-runtime contract and require candidate fixes to compose into heartbeat-independent yielded-parent resumption across ACP and native subagents.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available history signal across the ACP relay, heartbeat wake, and subagent registry seams that this product decision must coordinate.
